hook: A 1959 office tower on the site of one of Samuel Brannan's two 1853 Montgomery Street buildings.
address_note: The assessor's roll and SF Planning both file this parcel under 464 California Street; 420 Montgomery Street is the Montgomery frontage of the same parcel and is the address the 1878 source names.

parcel.note: Business addresses are usually deferred on this site; this page exists because the address was named in the prompting source.

historic_status.reason: No evaluation and 45 years or older

historic_district.note: A spatial query against the historic-district boundaries returns no district for this parcel.

permits.description: roof removed and replaced to meet cool-roof requirements
whole-building electrical service replacement and distribution repair, with the architectural, plumbing and HVAC work needed to accommodate it
voluntary one-for-one replacement of the fire-alarm system, with no associated construction
new exterior maintenance and window-washing system, with new and modified code-compliant guardrails
fire sprinklers installed on the sixth and ninth floors, the penthouse and mechanical penthouse and part of the ground floor, under the high-rise retrofit ordinance
seismic bracing of the entry-lobby mezzanine

permits_note: Six of the 268 filings on this address are shown; the rest are office tenant improvements floor by floor and the mechanical, electrical and fire-alarm permits that accompany them.

narrative.lead: Samuel Brannan put up the second of a pair of Montgomery Street buildings on this site in 1853; the building standing here replaced it.

historical_record.description: Samuel Brannan erected buildings at 400 and 420 Montgomery Street out of the profits of real-estate investments; they were then considered ornaments of the city and evidence of confidence in its future.
